_help: Gestures: rotate_left, rotate_right, press, press_rotate_left, press_rotate_right.
Action types: passthrough (Plasma handles the knob's own key: volume / mute / brightness), shortcut, scroll, mouse, shell, noop.
shortcut keys: ctrl shift alt win + a letter/digit/f1..f24/left/right/up/down/enter/esc/space/tab/[ ] - = , . / and media names
(volume_up volume_down mute play_pause next_track previous_track brightness_up brightness_down). 'command'/'cmd' is treated as ctrl.
scroll: dy > 0 scrolls up, dx > 0 scrolls right; optional keys are held while scrolling (ctrl = zoom).
every: act only on every Nth tick; use 2 if one detent of your knob fires an action twice.
apps: key is the window class KWin reports (google-chrome, firefox, org.kde.okular...), or 'class|text' to match only when the window title contains text.
The settings window lists the apps it has seen under 'Discovered apps'.
An app entry only needs the gestures it changes; the rest fall back to global.
language: "vi" or "en"; leave it out to follow the system language.

led: colour of the knob's lights per app (RRGGBB or off); desktop = the Plasma desktop; auto gives other apps their brand colour or a fixed colour from their name. Close the vendor ANTICATER app, it holds the lights.
